stories.title: Two Microsoft SharePoint Flaws Can Be Chained to Hack Servers Without a Password
stories.description: Microsoft SharePoint flaws can be chained to bypass authentication and remotely take control of vulnerable servers without a password.

stories.title: Critical Gitea RCE Actively Exploited as Reported Attack Drops Miner-Like Payload
stories.description: CISA adds CVE-2026-60004 to KEV amid active Gitea RCE exploitation; a separate reported attack deployed a miner-like dropper.

stories.title: New CoreRAT Malware Gives Core Werewolf Hackers Full Control of Compromised Systems
stories.description: Core Werewolf uses Telegram phishing and fake government files to deploy CoreRAT, enabling remote control of Windows systems.

stories.title: Fake Apple Support AI Calls Target Stolen-Device Owners for Passcodes and 2FA Codes
stories.description: AnonyMousKIT uses AI voice agents posing as Apple Support to request passcodes, Apple ID credentials, and live 2FA codes from theft victims.

stories.title: CISA Warns of Exploited Gitea Vulnerability
stories.description: CVE-2026-60004 is a remote code execution vulnerability patched by Gitea developers in late July with the release of version 1.27.1.

stories.title: Linux Turns 35 – Hobby Kernel Now Powers Cloud, Android, and Global Cyber Defense
stories.description: Thirty-five years later, that hobby sits under the internet, the public cloud, Android, and every system on the TOP500 supercomputer list.

stories.title: Multiple OpenSSL Flaws Let Remote Attackers Crash Servers and Corrupt Heap Memory
stories.description: OpenSSL has issued a fresh security advisory disclosing seven vulnerabilities across its cryptographic library, ranging from a heap-corrupting write bug to memory-exhaustion flaws in its QUIC and DTLS implementations.
